content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Post Doctoral Fellow Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Gandhinagar Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Gandhinagar Post Doctoral Fellow Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Post Doctoral Fellow: PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering field (Candidates with thesis submitted are also eligible), Track record of publications in reputed peer-reviewed journals, Minimum 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Please refer to the official notification for Selection Process details.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Gandhinagar Post Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Gandhinagar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar) for their research department in Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position under this recruitment notification released by IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position is 15-10-2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Post-Doctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering field, along with a strong publication record and specific academic percentages.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Post-Doctoral Fellow position will receive a monthly salary ranging between ₹72,000 and ₹84,000 per month based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 is strictly online through the official recruitment portal provided by the institution.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for applying to the Post-Doctoral Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this IIT Gandhinagar opening?
faq.answer: The Post-Doctoral Fellow position offered by the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is a temporary research-oriented job opportunity.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I apply online for IIT Gandhinagar Post-Doctoral Fellow 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official recruitment website link provided in the important links section of this notification article.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF containing complete guidelines, advertisement details, and eligibility criteria can be accessed via the important links table in this article.
